convert_fairseq_to_hf: run the script to convert a Fairseq mGENRE model to HuggingFace PyTorch, Flax, and TensorFlow formats
run_remove_ignore_keys: run remove_ignore_keys_ to strip version and output projection keys from a PyTorch state dict
run_make_linear_from_emb: run make_linear_from_emb to create a Linear layer from an embedding weight tensor
review_remove_ignore_keys: review the remove_ignore_keys_ function to understand which state dict keys are filtered during model conversion
review_make_linear_from_emb: review the make_linear_from_emb function to understand how embedding weights are reused as a linear projection layer
